# Inventory Sync Portal

> B2B Sales Catalog & Inventory management platform for wholesale bath fittings and sanitary ware.

## Key Capabilities & Core Pages
- [Home](https://wetta.com/): Product overview and primary landing experience.
- [Sales Catalog](https://wetta.com/catalog): Product catalog with pricing for B2B buyers.
- [Admin](https://wetta.com/admin): Inventory management console.

## Technology & Engineering Standards
- Built with Next.js App Router (React), leveraging Server-Side Rendering (SSR).
- Utilizes `framer-motion` for fluid, physics-based Apple-style interactions.
- Strictly follows WCAG 2.1 accessibility guidelines and semantic HTML5 structure.
- Adheres to `not-vibecoded` production readiness standards.
